projects_subtitle: Discover my recent achievements in Web development.
p1_desc: Front-end development for a real estate rental app. Built a dynamic interface using React and responsive design.
p1_long: CONTEXT: In this project, I developed the front-end of the Kasa apartment rental app, an industry leader in France. OBJECTIVES: The main mission was to completely redesign the site using a modern stack to ensure smooth and dynamic navigation. TECHNICAL STACK: The application was built entirely with React and React Router, while styles were managed via the Sass preprocessor. DEVELOPED SKILLS: I deepened my mastery of reusable component architecture and implemented complex logic for carousels. RESULTS: The final deliverable is a high-performance and responsive web app, offering a consistent user experience. IMPROVEMENT PERSPECTIVES: An interesting evolution would be to integrate a global state management solution like Redux to facilitate adding wishlist features.
p2_desc: Back-end design for a book rating site using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
p2_long: CONTEXT: This project involved creating the back-end for a book rating site for a small bookstore looking to modernize its services. OBJECTIVES: The challenge was to develop a robust REST API allowing users to publish books and assign ratings securely. TECHNICAL STACK: The server was built with Node.js and Express, using a MongoDB database and the Sharp library for image processing. DEVELOPED SKILLS: I learned to secure an application via JWT authentication and optimize media storage through automatic file resizing. RESULTS: The system now allows smooth CRUD management while ensuring user data integrity. IMPROVEMENT PERSPECTIVES: The project could be enhanced by implementing an advanced search engine based on book categories or authors.
p3_desc: Design and deployment of my digital identity (Vite, React, technical SEO).
p3_long: CONTEXT: As a junior web integrator, I designed my professional portfolio to centralize my projects and demonstrate my technical expertise. OBJECTIVES: The major challenge was to create a modern interface while ensuring impeccable digital accessibility according to WCAG standards. TECHNICAL STACK: I used the Vite build tool with the React library and the Sass preprocessor for a modular and efficient architecture. DEVELOPED SKILLS: This project allowed me to master accessibility auditing via the WAVE tool and solve complex color contrast issues. RESULTS: The site is now fully responsive and displays a perfect accessibility score, ensuring an inclusive user experience for all. IMPROVEMENT PERSPECTIVES: I plan to add a dark mode for visual comfort and deepen semantic SEO optimization.
p4_desc: Travel agency landing page integration using HTML and CSS without frameworks.
p4_long: CONTEXT: I was tasked with creating the website for a travel agency named Booki, allowing users to find accommodation and activities. OBJECTIVES: The primary goal was to transform a static mockup into a functional and adaptive web interface without using frameworks. TECHNICAL STACK: Development relied exclusively on HTML5 and CSS3, using Flexbox technology for the layout. DEVELOPED SKILLS: I strengthened my understanding of the Mobile First approach and rigorous integration of pixel-perfect Figma mockups. RESULTS: The final deliverable is a fluid interface offering intuitive navigation between different categories of tourist offers. IMPROVEMENT PERSPECTIVES: Adding JavaScript would allow for dynamic filters to refine hotel searches in real-time.
p5_desc: SEO optimization and performance debugging for a professional photographer.
p5_long: CONTEXT: This project involved optimizing a professional photographer's existing website to improve its visibility and speed. OBJECTIVES: The mission targeted reducing image load times and debugging faulty JavaScript components. TECHNICAL STACK: Optimization was achieved through Lighthouse analysis, the use of Schema.org tags, and media resource compression. DEVELOPED SKILLS: I learned to diagnose critical performance issues and implement local and technical SEO techniques. RESULTS: The interventions doubled the performance score on mobile and significantly improved organic search ranking. IMPROVEMENT PERSPECTIVES: Implementing a more modern image gallery system could further increase visual engagement for clients.
p6_desc: Online booking platform for entrepreneurs, currently under development
p6_long: Infintime is my capstone project from my web development training. It's a booking platform that lets entrepreneurs manage their schedule, services and clients, while offering their clients a simple way to book appointments. Project in progress (React, Node.js, SCSS).
